sources.title: Canonical loader, identity, snapshot and source confinement
facts_used: Project carries records, by_id, relations, canonical locations, selected sources and a snapshot including input/helper digests. load_project validates locked local imports and selected canonical files.

The compact profile has no generic process step/order field. Source locators support section:, line:/lines: and json:. source_status reports current/stale/unavailable; assert_current requires all evidence current and is intended for builds/publication.
load_project is read-only but does not itself establish atomic multi-file publication materialization.

sources.title: Existing deterministic ranking and payload limits
facts_used: match/ranked order exact stable ID, preferred label, alias and lexical matches deterministically; stable IDs break ties.

search defaults semantic=True; explain expands sources, bindings and all related relations before envelope truncation, so compact reader summaries require a thin adapter before pagination, not slicing existing rich results.
limits preserves maximum 100 results, 8 hops and 32000 bytes under stricter project limits.

sources.title: Existing relation identity, direction and traversal bounds
facts_used: neighbors preserves relation IDs, direction and a visited-node ceiling of min(100, configured max_limit). Its available_results reports discovered results and is not a whole-graph total.
Canonical subject/predicate/object are distinct from traversal direction. A one-hop paged reader projection must preserve that distinction and the existing CLI contract.

sources.title: Existing human service security and authoring coupling
facts_used: Workbench includes trusted authority, source selection, proposal/authoring imports, a workbench-profile prerequisite, session/bootstrap protections and explicit static asset routes.
It binds 127.0.0.1; checks exact Host, same Origin, JSON and CSRF; consumes bootstrap once; creates HttpOnly SameSite=Strict port-specific cookies; suppresses access logs.
dispatch exposes draft, validate, decide, publish, recover, advanced, generate and import routes, while state performs readiness/proposal inventory. A dedicated reader must not inherit it.
Source reads require current evidence and return a whole bounded text body; the reader needs registered exact-reference selection plus honest changed-source viewing.
Fallback exception handling returns str(exc); the reader requires fixed safe diagnostic mappings.

sources.title: Existing publication and recovery coordination
facts_used: publish/recover use control_records/ontology/publication.lock, immutable intents, receipts and recovery records. A transaction may leave partial canonical files after an injected or actual failure.
The reader must coordinate with these existing states without creating another writer lock protocol or invoking compile/publication/recovery.

sources.title: Current old launch and agent commands
facts_used: The workbench command accepts --authority-file, --port and required --session-file, launches Workbench and writes one private bootstrap session file.

tasks.action: Create isolated neutral/core-only, second-namespace, small, representative and stress fixtures plus one requirement/AT-to-test matrix. Include semantic and malformed boundary cases without modifying live canonical knowledge.
risks: The core parser limits one @graph to 10000 records and reads bounded files; stress data must be partitioned within supported configured inputs rather than increasing loader contracts.
acceptance_criteria: The matrix names all REQ-001 through REQ-049 and AT-01 through AT-36 with future implementing files and evidence owners.

Fixtures include duplicate/shared labels with different namespace meaning, aliases, long fields, sources, parallel predicates, qualified/self/cyclic edges, high-degree hubs, stale/missing references, ordered and unordered processes.
Approximate 50/100, 1000/5000 and 5000/50000 entry/relation targets are labeled synthetic; loader byte/record ceilings are measured and distributed fixture files obey supported per-file bounds.
Fixtures and private session material are excluded from served production assets.
verification_steps: Run fixture loading/validation and document deliberately invalid cases as rejected cases, not valid canonical graphs.
Check every AT and requirement has a test/evidence route and that fixtures never appear in the production manifest.

tasks.title: Implement immutable snapshot acquisition and bounded cache
tasks.action: Build ontology_explorer_read snapshot acquisition over load_project with verified before/after selected inputs/helper/config digests and existing publication coordination. Create immutable record/source/adjacency indexes keyed by resolved root, project, snapshot, adapter and presentation versions; bound memory/concurrency and retire inactive views.
risks: A new lock protocol would conflict with existing publication; reuse the owner contract.
Stable partial writes require explicit refusal even when files no longer change.
acceptance_criteria: A newly served current view is validated and internally coherent; concurrent/partial publication yields bounded retry or knowledge_updating, never a mixed graph.

Existing publication.lock may be observed/acquired read-only when present; browsing creates no lock file, receipt, projection or coordination store. Missing-to-present lock races and unresolved selected-input intents are covered.
Retained old views are explicitly snapshot-bound and released when active readers finish; limits stop unbounded cache growth.
Source-change warnings do not invoke assert_current as a blanket reading refusal or repair evidence.
verification_steps: Use barriers/fault injection with actual publication/recovery helpers on disposable fixtures, including interrupted multi-file commits, missing lock creation race, source change and continuous churn.
Assert selected inputs and helper/config versions differ coherently; bound retries and measure immutable-view memory.
Instrument disallowed build/memory/optional-profile calls and verify none occur.

tasks.title: Implement deterministic compact search and validated pagination
tasks.action: Reuse canonical ranking and limits while creating compact summaries, exact type/ID category mapping, lifecycle visibility and stable signed cursors. Filter before pagination and serialize within the whole envelope budget; retain explicit incomplete coverage.
risks: Calling existing search then filtering its already truncated result would lose valid later matches.
Cursor last key must advance only over actually returned stable identities.
acceptance_criteria: Exact ID/preferred label/alias/definition search preserves canonical deterministic ranking with semantic=False and unchanged agent default.
Ambiguous labels return all matching identities with module/project distinctions; aliases keep one preferred identity.
Category/lifecycle filtering occurs before page slicing; stable continuation has no duplicate/skipped identity within a snapshot.
Signed cursors reject altered service/project/snapshot/query/filter/direction/sort scope and oversized tokens; no recursive browser state bypass exists.
Byte/time/item exclusions, unknown total and byte-limited empty results are represented honestly.
verification_steps: Compare exact/label/alias/lexical ordering with existing ranked() outputs and existing search(..., semantic=False) semantics.
Run multi-page filter, signature tamper, changed query/snapshot, duplicate labels, minimal byte budget and metadata-only limit fixtures.
Check serialized response bytes include metadata; instrument semantic/profile imports to prove ordinary explorer search does not invoke them.

tasks.title: Project exact entries, relationships and bounded neighborhoods
tasks.action: Implement exact entry and relation projections plus incoming/outgoing adjacency paging and one-hop neighborhoods. Resolve nodes/predicate labels from the same view and register compact source references without copying source bodies into search/graph responses.
risks: Do not interpret retrieval available_results as totalRelationships.
Raw graph positions or relation groups cannot create semantic assertions.
acceptance_criteria: Definitions/aliases/scope/examples/non-examples/status/module/location retain recorded wording; absent fields remain absent.
Every edge retains exact relation ID, subject/predicate/object, direction, qualifiers, classification and evidence refs, including parallel relations and self-loops.
Layer selection distinguishes semantic relations, inferred/derived/external facts, type/source associations and navigation categories.
Per-request traversal/items/bytes and max visited nodes respect existing contracts; total coverage applies only to the requested scope.
Dangling references rejected by canonical validation remain a specific read error with safe underlying ID details; valid fixture projections never fabricate endpoint labels.
verification_steps: Compare normalized fields directly with canonical fixture bytes and check source/reference identity deterministically.
Exercise incoming traversal, two predicates/same endpoints, cycles/self-loops, qualifiers, missing references, exact deprecated entries and one-hop bounds.
Check the graph/list normalized data can enumerate exactly the same edge identities, endpoints, warnings and scope.

tasks.title: Implement confined registered source excerpts and freshness
tasks.action: Resolve source opens from selected entry/relation plus registered snapshot reference ID, revalidate bytes and confinement, and return an exact verified locator excerpt or explicitly labeled bounded text with recorded/current evidence versions.
risks: An allowlisted file alone is insufficient: the reference must also belong to the selected identity.
A stale locator may no longer identify the original passage and must be labeled accordingly.
acceptance_criteria: Sources open only when registered to the selected identity/reference in the selected snapshot and allowed by canonical/module source selection.
Changed bytes remain visibly different from recorded evidence; the previous entry remains available and no hash/configuration is rewritten.
Exact line/JSON/unique section extraction is distinguished from fallback bounded excerpts; unsupported/ambiguous locators never claim an exact cited passage.
Traversal/absolute path/symlink/unselected references and oversized or unsafe bodies fail safely; no external fetch, embedded instruction or executable HTML occurs.
verification_steps: Exercise encoded traversal, symlink components, absolute paths, reference reassignment/cross-snapshot spoofing and paths beyond the allowlist.
Change sources between entry/open and during open; verify current versus recorded hashes and immutable entry context.
Test section ambiguity, long content, line/JSON bounds and safe error redaction. Compare all protected bytes/timestamps before and after.

tasks.title: Implement dedicated read-only dispatcher and resource limits
tasks.action: Create ontology_explorer.py as an independent bounded loopback HTTP service with exact read endpoint dispatch, strict envelopes, JSON/request-size/deadline/concurrency/memory controls and short fixed diagnostic mappings. Do not subclass Workbench or import its authoring dispatcher.
risks: ThreadingHTTPServer defaults are not sufficient concurrency/deadline protection; enforce worker/admission and read/write timeouts.
acceptance_criteria: Only six reader operations and session/health functionality are dispatchable; every old write/query/generate/profile/Task endpoint fails without mutation.
Project root is chosen by the server at launch; request schemas reject actor/grant/root/scope/function/command fields.
Request bytes, elapsed work, concurrent materializations and response/cache memory have independent finite limits and truthful resource-limit results.
Unexpected failures reveal no Python exception text, credential, source body or out-of-project path; diagnostics retain safe codes.
verification_steps: Exercise actual HTTP requests for every allowed read and every forbidden old/generic endpoint, including malformed/oversized JSON and concurrent exhaustion.
Inspect imports/call graph for forbidden authoring and optional runtime dependencies.
Assert error envelopes are bounded and safe while source/entry regions remain distinguishable to the client.

tasks.title: Implement isolated one-use reading sessions
tasks.action: Reuse the established Host/Origin/CSRF/bootstrap protections in a reader-owned session component, bound to one service/root. Consume bootstrap once and establish fresh reader-only cookies/session memory; preserve no old authoring credential.
risks: Cookies are host-scoped, not port-scoped; service-instance isolation must prevent collisions.
Loopback HTTP cookie protections must be assessed honestly rather than claiming TLS Secure on HTTP.
acceptance_criteria: Loopback binding is exact; hostile Host/Origin/cross-site/CSRF/session credentials return no project data.
Cookies and CSRF state are isolated across concurrent local services and project roots, including port reuse/restart; expiry is enforced.
Bootstrap URL is one-use/short-lived and access logs contain no credentials; startup runtime files are exclusively created and narrowly owned if used.
Browser state will remove bootstrap from history/copy routes; safe new-tab entry links authenticate without leaking or reusing authoring authority.
verification_steps: Run concurrent actual local services with cross-cookie/CSRF/bootstrap replay probes and wrong-project credentials.
Exercise expiry, existing-cookie reconnect, restart/port reuse, no-CORS OPTIONS and service stop; inspect only redacted results.
Capture before/after exact runtime file manifest and confirm no undocumented session artifacts or logs are created.

tasks.title: Serve manifest-owned production assets with narrow CSP
tasks.action: Implement an explicit build/publication script that writes reviewed hashed JS/CSS/assets plus a complete manifest under explorer/assets/, and serve only that manifest with safe MIME/no-store/security headers. Keep the actual production CSP compatible with local renderer use and deny unknown assets.
risks: A frontend build may inject inline style attributes for canvas sizing; document any narrowly scoped style mechanism required and prove it without broad script exceptions.
acceptance_criteria: Normal launch serves installed manifest-listed resources only and performs no build/install/CDN/remote fetch.
Missing/mismatched assets produce incomplete_package with a maintenance route; source maps/package-manager caches/source tree are not served.
Unknown/traversing/symlinked asset requests fail and correct MIME/CSP/nosniff/referrer/frame policies apply.
The manifest binds package lock, source/build identity and notices; output avoids the excluded dist/build directory names.
verification_steps: Build a minimal actual application entry through the chosen reviewed toolchain after explicit installation authority; validate every served asset digest.
Run asset traversal, query/path encoding, source-map, directory and symlink negative tests.
Use the production CSP from the actual service in later browser tests; reject unsafe-eval or broad inline/remote exceptions.

tasks.title: Add explicit reader launch and bounded health inspection
tasks.action: Add the reviewed core reader launch and narrow health commands without requiring workbench-profile enablement or publication authority. Document missing-assets/configuration/session handling and the exact runtime lifecycle; leave old command cutover to its gated retirement task.
risks: Existing advanced-health reports workbench identity and may require a separate legacy assessment path during transition.
acceptance_criteria: The proposed explore --open command starts only the selected reader service and optionally opens a fresh safe bootstrap entry under explicit launch authority.
Health distinguishes installed/configured/running/readable/stale/wrong-project/unavailable without unrelated optional readiness sweeps or startup side effects.
Service identity differs from sys4ai-ontology-workbench; health uses a bounded explicit loopback origin and never accepts a bootstrap URL.
Old authoring CLI behavior is classified and preserved until qualified cutover; no documentation claims the reader can restart a stopped process from a web page.
verification_steps: Run launch/stop/health with optional advanced configuration and runtimes absent, invalid assets/configuration and wrong project origin.
Assert health is bounded and does not provision, read proposal inventory or expose root/source/session details to unauthenticated requests.
Compare help/schema/docs spelling with the exact implemented commands.

tasks.title: Implement accessible shell, Overview and view preferences
tasks.action: Create semantic navigation for Overview, Terms, Processes and Map with visible project/search identity, reviewed starting points, help/theme controls and responsive navigation. Persist only namespaced harmless preferences with reset.
acceptance_criteria: Only four reading destinations appear; no management metrics, raw storage kinds, hidden Advanced controls or whole-graph initial fetch is used.
Overview uses explicit configured starting IDs/project purpose; missing starting points and empty local extensions expose honest core/category/search browsing.
Light/dark/system themes and preferences reset affect presentation only, scoped by project identity/root discriminator.
Semantic headings/navigation, visible search, reflow, focus and primary controls support the WCAG target.
verification_steps: Inspect network/module loads for absent authoring assets and whole-project graph requests.
Run neutral/core-only and differently named project fixtures, preference isolation/reset, initial theme and narrow navigation checks.

tasks.title: Implement deterministic search and discovery UI
tasks.action: Connect visible labeled search/submit, optional combobox suggestions, alphabetical/category browsing, result cards, removable filter chips and bounded continuation to the reader search API.
acceptance_criteria: Search result labels/definitions/disambiguation/match reasons match canonical data without formula or generated text.
The query remains visible through no-match, filter and byte/time-limited states; clear filters and continuation remain meaningful.
Autocomplete supports Arrow Up/Down, Enter and Escape dismissal without erasing the query, while ordinary submit remains available.
Filtered later pages remain reachable and response scope/unknown counts are labeled honestly.
verification_steps: Run AT-02 through AT-06 against actual service fixture responses, including duplicate alias/label and later-page category matches.
Review combobox semantics against current WAI-ARIA primary guidance during implementation and test keyboard/screen-reader announcements.

tasks.title: Implement faithful entry, relationship and source reading
tasks.action: Render recorded definitions first, optional source-backed detail sections, incoming/outgoing relation sentences and precise relationship details. Add a bounded source drawer retaining entry context and independent lifecycle/fact/freshness warnings.
acceptance_criteria: Recorded fields remain faithful, aliases resolve to preferred identity, technical details remain inspectable and absent sections are omitted.
Deprecated/draft/inferred statuses and source mismatch are distinct; no verified badge equates approval/freshness/truth/authority.
Each relationship preserves canonical direction, qualifiers and exact relation ID; parallel predicates remain separate inspectable records.
Source drawer opens the exact registered reference, safely escapes content and reports extraction/freshness limitations; focus moves and restores predictably.
verification_steps: Run AT-07/08/09/13/14/19/20/26/27 with canonical byte comparison, long qualifiers and changed sources.
Test drawer open/close/Escape focus restoration and verify malicious labels, links and source markup remain inert.

tasks.title: Implement source-supported process reading
tasks.action: Build Processes as a reviewed selection of canonical identities using entry/relationship/source reads. Present only supported purpose/applicability/roles/inputs/outputs/documents and source-quoted ordering, with numbered text before any optional map link.
acceptance_criteria: Supported process fields and ordering cite exact canonical/source support; unsupported fields are absent.
When order is absent the exact sentence appears: An ordered description has not been recorded. These are the documented relationships.
No dependencies, relatedTo path, diagram branch or left-to-right placement become an execution sequence; pages expose no Run action.
Source/long process text remains vertically readable on narrow screens.
verification_steps: Run AT-17/18 with canonical ordered-source and unordered fixtures and compare rendered sequence to exact cited source sections.
Inspect the live inventory disposition: unexamined content is not reported as absence, and missing content remains a separate existing review-process item.

tasks.title: Implement identity history and race-safe read state
tasks.action: Centralize read requests and state transitions with project/snapshot/query/selection request keys, sequence checks and abort support. Preserve route/query/filters/selection/focus/source intent through Back/Forward and coherent knowledge refresh; implement safe copy actions and regional failure states.
risks: Source freshness can change independently of retained ontology snapshot; the UI must distinguish current source observation from a snapshot replacement.
acceptance_criteria: Entry A responses arriving after B never replace B even when cancellation fails; renderers/components emit intentions through the read layer.
Back/Forward and Terms/Map navigation use exact stable IDs and restore useful state; deliberate selection adds one history event, camera motion does not.
Bootstrap is consumed and removed before safe intended route/history/copy state is retained; local links exclude credentials and explain live local service dependence.
Snapshot conflict preserves the screen and offers Refresh knowledge; refresh atomically replaces incompatible entries/relations/expansions/cursors.
Expiry/service stop preserve readable context and safe desired route, while regional failures do not blank unrelated content.
verification_steps: Run AT-21/22/23 with delayed out-of-order responses, failed abort, concurrent canonical update, expiry and service stop.
Inspect browser history, copied local links/stable IDs and storage for session/source bodies; test authenticated new-tab links.
Exercise focus after route changes and accessible status announcements without layout-frame noise.

tasks.title: Implement normalized graph/List data and text actions
tasks.action: Build one browser normalization/projection of returned neighborhood data and a first-class semantic relationship List. Provide open entry/precise relationship/source, focus and bounded more-connections actions from that shared normalized set.
acceptance_criteria: List and graph preserve the exact same relation IDs/endpoints/direction/qualifiers/warnings/filters/returned scope.
List users can complete every substantive map reading/exploration action without canvas, drag, hover or double-click.
Browser cumulative bounds and server/request exclusions are distinct; no global completeness claim is fabricated.
Broken/absent relationships produce specific truthful states with safe IDs inspectable.
verification_steps: Run AT-13/14/15/16/29 parity and keyboard workflows using the actual normalized graph response.
Compare semantic content sets and focus/source/more actions across both modes, including truncation and stale-source warnings.

tasks.title: Implement restrained renderer and explicit map interactions
tasks.action: Implement the small Cytoscape renderer adapter using canonical node/edge IDs, finite built-in layout and stable incremental position reuse. Add visible pan/zoom/Fit/Reset/Focus here/Show more/List controls while keeping selection, focus and camera distinct.
risks: A layout algorithm must not become a process engine or unbounded worker.
An oversized qualifier must remain complete in accessible details even when edge label space is short.
acceptance_criteria: Default map requests one hop near evaluated 25-node/50-edge targets only within stricter project/request/byte budgets; no unfiltered graph fetch occurs.
Selection highlights and updates readable details without moving camera or graph focus; Focus here and Show more are explicit bounded operations.
Parallel relations/self-loops/cycles/qualifiers remain meaningful; selected/adjacent edge labels and canonical direction stay inspectable.
Expansion preserves prior positions where practical, performs bounded adjustment and stops; no continuous motion/physics UI/importance sizing/3D appears.
Legend and exact guidance read: Select a term to read it. Use Focus here to explore its connections.
verification_steps: Run AT-10/11/12/13/14/15 in the production renderer; inspect selected/focus identity and camera before/after.
Stress high-degree expansion to evaluated cumulative 100-node/200-edge ceiling and verify alternative focus/filter/list guidance.
Check reduced motion, labels at crowded zoom and layout timeout fallback without interpreting position as semantics.

tasks.title: Verify map cleanup, responsive controls and renderer failure
tasks.action: Implement lazy graph import/instance lifecycle, listener/timer/observer cleanup and bounded layout timeout recovery. Complete narrow-screen selected details, List visibility, keyboard controls, focus restoration and stable text fallback.
acceptance_criteria: Leaving Map disposes its instance, listeners, timers and resize observers; no hidden simulation continues and selection does not rebuild the graph.
AT-34 renderer failure leaves definitions, relationship List and source inspection usable; retry creates no remote service or hidden computation.
At 320 CSS pixels, substantial zoom, both themes and reduced motion, controls/status/text remain operable; mobile Map has dismissible details and visible List.
Focus and announcements reflect meaningful user state rather than layout frames, with no hundreds of invisible graph tab stops.
verification_steps: Run instrumented repeated Map enter/leave and selection tests for instance counts, observer/listener/timer disposal and memory growth.
Force module/layout/canvas failure under actual production CSP; complete the same knowledge tasks through List.
Run AT-29/30/34 and inspect keyboard focus and narrow layout in production browser renders.

tasks.title: Build and exercise the complete production read workflow
tasks.action: Create a reproducible production build and run the actual Python reader with offline networking under its deployed CSP. Exercise Overview/search/entry/process/map/List/source/history/expiry and fault workflows against canonical fixtures; attach evidence to every applicable AT.
acceptance_criteria: The actual manifest-bound production reader and renderer work with network egress unavailable, no remote assets and optional AI/RDF/standards/inference services absent.
AT-01 through AT-23 and AT-27/28/32/34 have actual expected behavior or an explicit failing result; implementation gaps are corrected before cutover.
Source HTML/scripts/links remain inert under real CSP; build/runtime identity and service command are recorded.
Loading, empty, limit, invalid canonical, stale source, mixed snapshot, late response, expired session and renderer failure states retain useful context.
verification_steps: Run the production build command from the reviewed package lock and verify installed asset hashes and offline network observations.
Run the browser suite against the real Python production service, not the Vite dev server.
Reopen exact evidence outputs and compare each recorded result with its AT/requirement criteria; retain failures and content gaps separately.

Record individual observed result and exact evidence locator for each scenario: AT-01, AT-02, AT-03, AT-04, AT-05, AT-06, AT-07, AT-08, AT-09, AT-10, AT-11, AT-12, AT-13, AT-14, AT-15, AT-16, AT-17, AT-18, AT-19, AT-20, AT-21, AT-22, AT-23, AT-27, AT-28, AT-32, AT-34. A range or aggregate suite result does not replace the per-scenario record.

tasks.title: Prove read isolation, unavailable writes and non-mutation
tasks.action: Run hostile HTTP/browser probes and a protected hash/timestamp audit across the complete production read workflow. Exercise two live isolated services and source/asset attacks; verify that no browser read can reach authoring or install/build/repair anything.
risks: Non-mutation must include generated products and control records, not only canonical ontology files.
acceptance_criteria: AT-24/25/26/27 pass against actual service requests, with old endpoint attempts causing no protected change or disclosure.

AT-33 compares ontology, configuration, sources, memory data/configuration, proposals, receipts and generated products before/after; only individually documented startup session artifacts and harmless preferences are exempt.
No broad .sys4ai exemption hides implicit compile/wiki/semantic/memory changes; browsing works while wiki is missing/stale.
Cross-root namespace/cookie/cache/reference/cursor attacks fail and no bootstrap material appears in logs/evidence/history/copies.
verification_steps: Run actual session/Host/Origin/CSRF/CORS/port-reuse/cross-service probes and every forbidden dispatcher route.
Compare exact protected file hashes and relevant timestamps around startup separately from browsing, then stop and inspect owned runtime cleanup.
Test arbitrary/encoded/traversing/symlink/unknown manifest paths and source refs, and assert safe bounded error response content.
Record individual observed result and exact evidence locator for each scenario: AT-24, AT-25, AT-26, AT-27, AT-33. A range or aggregate suite result does not replace the per-scenario record.

tasks.title: Evaluate production accessibility and comprehension
tasks.action: Run automated accessibility checks plus manual keyboard and actual screen-reader knowledge-task walkthroughs on the production bundle. Evaluate relationship/process understanding with an unfamiliar participant when available, otherwise record the owner walkthrough and the unperformed broader validation.
risks: A scan pass or component choice does not establish WCAG compliance.
If only the owner participates, do not claim novice usability validation.
acceptance_criteria: Major tasks complete by keyboard and List, with semantic navigation, accessible search, predictable source/route focus, unobscured focus and useful announcements.
Contrast, 24-by-24 target criterion/exceptions, 320 CSS-pixel reflow, substantial zoom, both themes and reduced motion are assessed on the actual interface.
Evidence names actual macOS VoiceOver/Safari and other tested versions; unavailable Windows combination is explicitly unperformed.

Knowledge tasks include term finding, distinctions, directed relation meaning, neighbor-and-return, process/missing order and evidence freshness; roughly 30-second discovery is a proposed target, not a claim.
Wrong turns/help/misinterpretations/participant wording are recorded without statistical generalization; reversed-edge or layout-as-causality misunderstandings are resolved before polish.
verification_steps: Run current automated browser accessibility checks and compare results with manual keyboard and VoiceOver/Safari walkthrough records.
Inspect contrast/focus/reflow states in real theme and zoom conditions; document any assistive-technology limits.
Record small exploratory comprehension rounds with privacy-minimized observations and retest high-impact fixes.
Record individual observed result and exact evidence locator for each scenario: AT-29, AT-30. A range or aggregate suite result does not replace the per-scenario record.

tasks.title: Measure bounded production performance and stress behavior
tasks.action: Benchmark the real production candidate repeatedly on the actual target host across labeled small/representative/stress fixtures. Report cold/warm timing, memory, payloads, loader capacity and degradation while preserving all integrity checks; optimize only measured bottlenecks within approved contracts.
risks: Qualified proposed budgets may not be reached on the actual host; report measurements and disposition material misses before an unqualified performance claim.
acceptance_criteria: AT-36 records actual median/p95, hardware/browser/build/dataset size and cold/warm conditions; representative and stress behavior remains bounded and honest.

Targets retain conditions: about 2s cold readable screen, warm search p95 200ms excluding debounce, warm entry p95 250ms, focused roughly 25/50 graph usable about 1.5s, selection feedback 100ms without full recreation.
Small roughly 50/100, representative 1000/5000 and stress 5000/50000 fixture scales are measured against actual loader capacity; stress success means bounded degradation, not whole-graph rendering.
Source-validation latency is measured separately when dominant; immutable input reuse precedes contract changes, with no stale-as-current shortcut.
Bundle compressed size and memory become inspectable regression baselines; expansion preserves current view/progress/cancellation.
verification_steps: Run repeated measured workflows with fixed corpus/build and instrument applied-result timestamps, renderer usable/selection feedback and server resource counters.
Check enforced traversal/items/bytes/cumulative browser limits and memory across high-degree and repeated navigation workloads.
Record first failing capacity threshold and safe rejection when stress exceeds a supported loader file/record bound; never silently increase shared agent caps.
Record individual observed result and exact evidence locator for each scenario: AT-36. A range or aggregate suite result does not replace the per-scenario record.

tasks.title: Update current delivery contracts and neutral Template assets
tasks.action: Update reusable ontology docs, explorer neutral schema/starter, explicit configuration mappings and current initializer/static capability inventories for the reader package. Run Template check, inspect its exact change set, then apply through the existing owner and validate the generated neutral package.
risks: Do not manually edit mapped Template files or remove historic v9 files merely to make new tests pass.
acceptance_criteria: Production assets, manifest, dependency lock/build instructions and notices ship through the source collection/Template pipeline; dist/build exclusions stay effective.
Neutral Template retains empty canonical local graphs, disabled optional runtimes, no depot IDs/labels or private records; categories/purpose derive from the selected project after specialization.
Current explorer capability inventory handles old workbench resource dependencies explicitly without relabeling prior initializer receipts or changing historical verification snapshots.
Only the registered Template is updated; all unknown/customized conflict rules and existing watcher evidence are honored.
verification_steps: Run tools/template_update.py check before apply; inspect exact source/destination manifest and current owner conflicts.
Run the existing Template contract and affected initializer tests, including older receipt preservation, missing assets, notices and installed reader inventory.
Reopen Template output, compare manifest asset digests and run read-only current Template check; if relying on watcher readiness inspect its fresh successful current-PID observation.

tasks.title: Apply separately authorized root adoption and isolation checks
tasks.action: Reinspect source and installed root copies/local guidance and finalize the exact adoption preview with overwrite/customization preservation. After specific authority, adopt only those files and test root, neutral Template through its documented identity handling, and an explicitly selected second-namespace fixture.
risks: Root has intentional local differences from reusable sources; blind package replacement is prohibited.
Neutral unresolved identity is not a failed requirement to invent a depot identity.
acceptance_criteria: The adoption receipt records exact source/destination files, before/after hashes, preserved customizations, checks and final diff; equal bytes or registry membership supply no authority.
AT-31 covers root, neutral Template behavior and second fixture with different namespace/shared label/different meaning: routes, caches, preferences, sources and sessions remain isolated.

Neutral Template has no fabricated identity; direct unconfigured startup reports configuration need or a properly specialized disposable Template fixture demonstrates reading, with that distinction documented.
Ordinary product projects, registry, unrelated edits and current ontology/memory/history remain intact.
verification_steps: Review exact adoption manifest and current root instructions before mutation; obtain the separately required exact operation authority.
Run actual production read/service/browser isolation across the three selected contexts and compare asset/build identity.
Inspect protected hashes and final diff; verify no recursive product update or registry edit occurred.
Record individual observed result and exact evidence locator for each scenario: AT-31. A range or aggregate suite result does not replace the per-scenario record.

tasks.title: Cut over normal launch and retire active authoring frontend
tasks.action: After adoption qualification, change the normal human entry point to the reader and implement the reviewed workbench deprecation behavior. Remove old authoring imports/routes/assets from active shipping destinations; relocate/preserve verified shared trusted authority helpers and non-browser callers as required by the baseline classification.
risks: Retirement may require a shared helper extraction before deletion; do not delete authority code just because it lived in the old service.
Reapply final source changes to Template and exact adopted root through their existing owner boundaries if cutover changes their bytes.
acceptance_criteria: Normal launch opens only the reader; old workbench command returns a documented deprecation error and explicitly rejects incompatible authoring/grant arguments.
No active frontend destination loads editor/review/advanced assets or reaches write dispatchers; a disabled widget or authoring=false flag is not the control.
Existing permitted agent/CLI retrieval/proposal/review/publication/authority/recovery operations and shared helpers retain behavior.
Historical ontology, memory, proposals, receipts and verification records are preserved; rollback changes only reviewed code/assets/configuration and preserves newer valid knowledge.
verification_steps: Re-run active caller inventory and scan production manifests/import graphs/launchers/docs for old frontend exposure.
Run old-command compatibility negatives and agent command regressions against isolated fixtures, independent of browser read-only tests.
Rehearse exact code/asset/config rollback on an isolated copy with newer knowledge and confirm newer records/history survive.

tasks.title: Record provenance effects and separately governed maintenance
tasks.action: After final helper/docs/assets settle, inventory every affected source reference, lock, certification and generated product. Record exact maintenance needs and route only authorized operations through their existing owners, keeping any browser frontend completion separate from ontology/documentation maintenance.
risks: Task execution and a plan cannot grant missing provenance publication authority; do not fabricate current certifications.
acceptance_criteria: Affected hashes/locked inputs/helper certifications/generated products are identified with current warnings; no mechanical hash repair silences a mismatch.
No reader path repairs, compiles or republishes; any maintenance operation has its separate current authority and direct receipt.
Release evidence distinguishes frontend delivery, optional/required maintenance effects and any remaining unperformed operation.
Rollback evidence preserves newer valid knowledge and publication/memory history.
verification_steps: Reinspect recorded source/helper/configuration provenance and relevant explicit owner health outputs after final bytes settle.
Compare required maintenance scope with current authority; retain a named pending operation when unavailable rather than broadening the Task.
Verify the final browser non-mutation boundary still holds after any separately authorized maintenance.

tasks.title: Run final agent, Template and integrated production regressions
tasks.action: Reopen final source/installed/Template artifacts and run the relevant existing agent retrieval, publication/recovery and Template/initializer suites independently of browser checks. Refresh only tests invalidated by cutover or other final changes and confirm integrated operation from the normal production launch.
acceptance_criteria: AT-35 shows no unintended agent retrieval/publication/recovery/Template behavior regression; pre-existing failures are separated from introduced failures.
Final actual production launch, core reads, process access, interactive map/List, source inspection, isolation and docs agree on the same build/command/schema.
Protected records/configuration/generated state are preserved across browser reads; exact authorized maintenance/adoption changes have distinct evidence.
Any code/bundle change after manual/performance qualification invalidates only affected results and is explicitly retested.
verification_steps: Run current core check and selected existing query/publication/advanced-publication/guard/health suites using installed fixture capabilities without provisioning.
Run Template check and affected initializer contract suites and verify final manifests/source/root parity within the exact adoption boundary.
Re-exercise the final production workflow and negative write probe; compare protected before/after evidence and current asset digest.
Record individual observed result and exact evidence locator for each scenario: AT-35. A range or aggregate suite result does not replace the per-scenario record.

tasks.title: Capture production visuals and operational handoff
tasks.action: Capture actual production views and finish launch/build/configuration/compatibility/help documentation with exact evidence links and private-data-safe images. Summarize measured performance/accessibility/usability limits and reversible migration.
acceptance_criteria: Actual production images include Overview, search results, populated entry, process, focused map, parallel-edge example, source drawer, incomplete-result and narrow-screen views.

The handoff records commit/build identity, changed-file map, exact commands/test summaries, browser/assistive-tech versions, measured limits, non-mutation, root/Template behavior, rollback, content gaps, pre-existing failures/skips and untested environments.
Evidence contains no bootstrap links, credentials or unsupported claims; external sharing is not implied and private source bodies are sanitized before any separately authorized sharing.
Normal use, missing-asset maintenance, expired/stopped service, stable ID/local link distinction and old-command deprecation are documented plainly.
verification_steps: Reopen every listed screenshot and verify it came from the final production build and required state.
Resolve all local evidence/doc links and compare each command/claim with current actual outputs.
Inspect images and reports for credentials/private source content; retain only the minimum useful evidence.

tasks.title: Audit every requirement and final preservation criterion
tasks.action: Perform a bidirectional final audit of all 49 requirements, 36 AT scenarios, implementation artifacts and current evidence. Reinspect protected artifacts after evidence collection, record truthful highest verification levels and stop at complete only when every required outcome is supported.
acceptance_criteria: Every requirement maps to performed implementation and every acceptance criterion has current evidence; every changed artifact maps back to a requirement or justified bounded design choice.
AT-01 through AT-36 have exact test/manual evidence or a clearly non-passing classification; no unperformed mandatory behavior is silently deferred.
Protected paths have a final affirmative preservation observation strictly after current implementation evidence; scope exceptions are exact and authorized.
Final report distinguishes static checks, fixture tests, real service/browser behavior and end-to-end delivery; remaining adoption/runtime/environment/maintenance limitations are explicit.
verification_steps: Reopen canonical plan, final requirements/AT matrix and changed-file manifest and check forward/reverse coverage, dependencies and stale evidence.
Read final actual outputs and compare to the exact TRD acceptance wording; do not infer pass from task labels.
Inspect final Git status/diff and protected hashes after the latest evidence and classify all outstanding failures or unavailable authority before any completion transition.
